blocks.en: Section 0: Introduction & CM Concepts

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 能夠定義 連續製造（Continuous Manufacturing, CM） 的核心特徵，並解釋為何 Q13 聚焦於「兩個或以上單元操作的整合系統」
blocks.en: Be able to define the core features of continuous manufacturing (CM) and explain why Q13 focuses on "integrated systems of two or more unit operations"

blocks.zh: 掌握 CM 的 三種模式：部分連續、全程連續、跨 DS/DP 邊界整合，以及各模式的適用場景
blocks.en: Understand the three CM modes: partly continuous, fully continuous, and integrated across the DS/DP boundary, and where each mode is applicable

blocks.zh: 理解 批次定義 在 CM 中的特殊性：三種 Q13 認可的批次大小定義方式（輸出量、輸入量、運行時間）
blocks.en: Understand what is special about the definition of a batch in CM: the three batch size definitions recognized by Q13 (output quantity, input quantity, run time)

blocks.zh: 了解 Q13 的 適用範圍：化學藥品、治療蛋白、新藥/學名藥/生物相似藥，以及批次製程轉換
blocks.en: Know the scope of Q13: chemical drugs, therapeutic proteins, new drugs/generics/biosimilars, and conversion of batch processes

blocks.zh: 清楚 Q13 與現有 ICH Quality Guidelines（Q7/Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11）的關係——Q13 是這些指南在 CM 場景中的「應用層」
blocks.en: Be clear on how Q13 relates to the existing ICH Quality Guidelines (Q7/Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11) - Q13 is the "application layer" of these guidelines for CM

blocks.zh: 1. Introduction｜導論
blocks.en: 1. Introduction

blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜Q13 聚焦「整合系統」而非單一單元操作
blocks.en: Key Point | Q13 focuses on the "integrated system", not on a single unit operation

blocks.zh: Q13 的範疇是「兩個或以上單元操作直接連接的 CM 系統」——這個看似技術性的定義有深刻的法規意涵：
blocks.en: The scope of Q13 is "CM systems in which two or more unit operations are directly connected" - this seemingly technical definition has deep regulatory implications:

blocks.zh: 單一連續單元操作（如灌流細胞培養、連續層析）不是 Q13 的主要焦點
blocks.en: A single continuous unit operation (such as perfusion cell culture or continuous chromatography) is not the primary focus of Q13

blocks.zh: 真正的 CM 是「整合系統」——各單元操作的上下游之間存在直接的材料流動和相互影響
blocks.en: A true CM process is an "integrated system" - there is direct material flow and mutual influence between the upstream and downstream unit operations

blocks.zh: 這種整合性帶來獨特的挑戰：一個單元操作的擾動（disturbance）可能通過物料流影響整個系統的輸出品質
blocks.en: This integration creates a distinct challenge: a disturbance in one unit operation can affect the output quality of the whole system through the material flow

blocks.zh: 因此，Q13 的控制策略必須從「系統整合」的視角設計，而不是把各單元操作的控制策略簡單加總。
blocks.en: The Q13 control strategy must therefore be designed from a "system integration" perspective, rather than simply adding up the control strategies of the individual unit operations.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明｜CM vs. 批次製造，就像「流水線」vs.「訂製工坊」
blocks.en: Analogy | CM vs. batch manufacturing is like an "assembly line" vs. a "custom workshop"

blocks.zh: 傳統批次製造就像「訂製工坊」——每個「批次」是一個獨立的產品，做完一批再做下一批，每次都是全新的開始。連續製造就像「汽車流水線」——原材料不斷投入，產品不斷產出，整個系統是一個持續運作的整體。在流水線上，若某個工位（單元操作）出了問題，不只影響那個工位的產品，還會影響整條流水線的狀態——上游的材料積壓、下游的供料中斷。這種「牽一髮動全身」的特性，正是 Q13 需要特別規範的原因。
blocks.en: Traditional batch manufacturing is like a "custom workshop": each batch is a separate product, the next batch starts only after the previous one is finished, and every time is a fresh start. Continuous manufacturing is like a "car assembly line": raw materials are fed in and product comes out without interruption, and the whole system runs as one continuous whole. On an assembly line, if one station (unit operation) has a problem, it affects more than the product at that station - it changes the state of the entire line: material piles up upstream and the supply to downstream is cut off. This "pull one hair and the whole body moves" characteristic is exactly why Q13 needs to set specific expectations.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Q13 說「治療蛋白的 CM 也適用」？治療蛋白的 CM（如灌流式單抗生產）與化學藥品的 CM（如固體口服製劑連續製造）在挑戰上有什麼本質差異？
blocks.en: Why does Q13 say that CM of therapeutic proteins is also covered? What are the fundamental differences in challenges between CM of therapeutic proteins (such as perfusion-based monoclonal antibody production) and CM of chemical drugs (such as continuous manufacturing of solid oral dosage forms)?

blocks.zh: 「批次製程轉換為 CM」為什麼被單獨提及為 Q13 的適用場景？轉換過程中最大的科學和法規挑戰是什麼？
blocks.en: Why is "conversion of a batch process to CM" specifically mentioned as an applicable scenario for Q13? What are the biggest scientific and regulatory challenges during the conversion?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Q13 在 ICH 架構中的定位
blocks.en: Core Concept: The position of Q13 in the ICH framework

blocks.zh: Q13（2022）是 ICH Q 系列的最新成員，專門針對連續製造（CM）的科學與法規框架。其在 ICH 架構中的關係：
blocks.en: Q13 (2022) is the newest member of the ICH Q series and is dedicated to the scientific and regulatory framework for continuous manufacturing (CM). Its relationship within the ICH framework is as follows:

blocks.zh: 2. CM Concepts｜連續製造概念
blocks.en: 2. CM Concepts

blocks.zh: CM 批次大小定義的三種方式及其含義
blocks.en: Three ways to define CM batch size and what they mean

blocks.zh:
方式 1：輸出物料量（Output Quantity）
  例：每次運行生產 500 kg 的製劑
  優點：直觀，與傳統批次概念最接近
  挑戰：CM 系統輸出量可能變動（運行時間、良率波動）

方式 2：輸入物料量（Input Quantity）
  例：每次運行投入 10 kg API + 90 kg 賦形劑
  優點：成本控制明確
  挑戰：輸入量 ≠ 輸出量（損耗、物料分流）

方式 3：定質量流速下的運行時間（Run Time）
  例：在 1 kg/min 的質量流速下運行 8 小時 = 一個批次
  優點：最直接反映 CM 的「時間-空間」特性
  常見：多以此方式定義最小/最大批次大小（Run Time Range）

批次大小定義為範圍：
  最小運行時間（min run time）→ 最小批次
  最大運行時間（max run time）→ 最大批次
  → 靈活應對市場需求波動，無需每次提交新的批次大小變更申請
blocks.en:
Option 1: Output Quantity
  Example: each run produces 500 kg of drug product
  Advantage: intuitive and closest to the traditional batch concept
  Challenge: the output of a CM system may vary (run time, yield fluctuation)

Option 2: Input Quantity
  Example: each run charges 10 kg API + 90 kg excipients
  Advantage: cost control is clear
  Challenge: input quantity ≠ output quantity (losses, material diversion)

Option 3: Run Time at a constant mass flow rate
  Example: running for 8 hours at a mass flow rate of 1 kg/min = one batch
  Advantage: most directly reflects the "time-space" nature of CM
  Common: the minimum/maximum batch size is mostly defined this way (Run Time Range)

Batch size defined as a range:
  Minimum run time (min run time) → minimum batch
  Maximum run time (max run time) → maximum batch
  → Flexibly responds to fluctuations in market demand without submitting a new batch size change application each time

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜批次大小「範圍」的法規優勢
blocks.en: Key Point | The regulatory advantage of a batch size "range"

blocks.zh: 將批次大小定義為範圍（如「最小 4 小時，最大 12 小時的運行時間」）是 CM 的重要法規優勢：
blocks.en: Defining the batch size as a range (for example, "minimum 4 hours, maximum 12 hours of run time") is an important regulatory advantage of CM:

blocks.zh: 傳統批次製造若需要改變批量（如放量生產），通常需要提交 Prior Approval 或 Notification
blocks.en: In traditional batch manufacturing, changing the batch size (for example, scale-up) usually requires a Prior Approval or Notification submission

blocks.zh: CM 系統若事先在申請中定義了批次大小範圍，在範圍內調整不構成 EC 變更
blocks.en: If the CM system has a batch size range defined in advance in the application, adjusting within that range does not constitute an EC change

blocks.zh: 這允許製造商根據市場需求彈性調整每次運行的時長，同時維持同一套已驗證的製程和控制策略
blocks.en: This allows the manufacturer to adjust the duration of each run flexibly according to market demand, while keeping the same validated process and control strategy

blocks.zh: 這是 CM 相對於批次製造的重大監管效率優勢之一。
blocks.en: This is one of the major regulatory efficiency advantages of CM over batch manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明｜CM 批次定義就像「排班制服裝廠」
blocks.en: Analogy | CM batch definition is like a "shift-based garment factory"

blocks.zh: 一條 24 小時運轉的服裝流水線，可以按不同方式定義「一個生產批次」：
blocks.en: A garment production line running 24 hours a day can define "one production batch" in different ways:

blocks.zh: 按輸出量：「生產完 1000 件」就是一批——但每批耗時可能不同
blocks.en: By output quantity: "producing 1000 pieces" is one batch - but each batch may take a different amount of time

blocks.zh: 按輸入量：「投入 50 匹布」就是一批——但可能裁剪出多少件不確定
blocks.en: By input quantity: "feeding in 50 rolls of fabric" is one batch - but how many pieces will be cut is uncertain

blocks.zh: 按運行時間（最常見）：「一個班次（8小時）」就是一批——最清楚、可追蹤、GMP 記錄最完整
blocks.en: By run time (most common): "one shift (8 hours)" is one batch - the clearest, most traceable, and with the most complete GMP records

blocks.zh: 時間範圍：「4-12 小時都算一批，視訂單量調整」——最靈活，允許生產計畫彈性
blocks.en: Time range: "anything from 4 to 12 hours counts as one batch, depending on order volume" - the most flexible, allowing flexible production planning

blocks.zh: 實務應用｜CDMO 導入 CM 的策略起點
blocks.en: Practical Application | Strategic starting point for a CDMO introducing CM

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，從批次製造轉向 CM 的策略應考慮：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the strategy for moving from batch manufacturing to CM should consider the following:

blocks.zh: 選擇混合模式作為入門點：先在高週轉、相對簡單的單元操作（如混合、制粒）導入連續模式，積累 CM 操作經驗
blocks.en: Choose a hybrid mode as the entry point: first introduce continuous mode in high-turnover, relatively simple unit operations (such as blending and granulation) to build CM operating experience

blocks.zh: 批次大小定義策略：建議採用「運行時間範圍」定義，在 MAA 申請中預先設定最小/最大運行時間，以最大化未來的生產靈活性
blocks.en: Batch size definition strategy: adopting a "run time range" definition is recommended; pre-setting the minimum/maximum run time in the MAA maximizes future production flexibility

blocks.zh: 投資 PAT 基礎設施：CM 系統有效運作的前提是即時監控，PAT 工具的投資是 CM 轉型的必要前提，也是申請文件的重要支撐元素
blocks.en: Invest in PAT infrastructure: effective operation of a CM system depends on real-time monitoring, so investment in PAT tools is a prerequisite for CM transformation and an important supporting element of the application dossier

blocks.zh: 在「部分連續 + 部分批次」的混合模式中，批次大小應如何定義？跨模式邊界的材料追蹤如何實現？
blocks.en: In a hybrid mode of "partly continuous + partly batch", how should the batch size be defined? How can material tracking across the mode boundary be achieved?

blocks.zh: Q13 說「其他批次大小定義方式也是可能的，只要有科學依據」——請提出一個在現有三種方式之外的合理定義，並說明其適用場景和潛在挑戰。
blocks.en: Q13 says "other approaches to defining batch size are possible, as long as they are scientifically justified" - propose a reasonable definition beyond the existing three, and explain its applicable scenarios and potential challenges.

blocks.zh: CM 的三種模式詳解
blocks.en: The three CM modes in detail

blocks.zh: Surge tanks/lines（緩衝槽/管線）：在各模式中，緩衝槽用於平衡上下游質量流速差異，防止因短暫流量不匹配導致系統中斷。這是 CM 系統設計的重要元素，直接影響系統的整合穩定性。
blocks.en: Surge tanks/lines: in all modes, surge tanks are used to balance differences in mass flow rate between upstream and downstream and to prevent system interruptions caused by short-term flow mismatches. This is an important element of CM system design and directly affects the stability of system integration.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Q13 的定位：ICH Q7/Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11 在連續製造整合系統中的應用層；聚焦兩個或以上直接連接的單元操作
blocks.en: Position of Q13: the application layer of ICH Q7/Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11 in integrated continuous manufacturing systems; focuses on two or more directly connected unit operations

blocks.zh: CM 的定義特徵：連續進料 + 連續製程轉化 + 連續出料；Q13 強調「整合系統」的視角，非個別單元操作
blocks.en: Defining features of CM: continuous feeding + continuous process transformation + continuous discharge; Q13 emphasizes the perspective of the "integrated system", not individual unit operations

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：化學藥品和治療蛋白的 DS 和 DP；新藥/學名藥/生物相似藥；以及批次製程的 CM 轉換
blocks.en: Scope: DS and DP of chemical drugs and therapeutic proteins; new drugs/generics/biosimilars; and CM conversion of batch processes

blocks.zh: 三種 CM 模式：部分連續（混合模式）→ 全程連續 → 跨 DS/DP 整合，複雜度依次升高，控制策略挑戰也越大
blocks.en: Three CM modes: partly continuous (hybrid mode) → fully continuous → integrated across DS/DP; complexity increases in this order, and so do the control strategy challenges

blocks.zh: 批次大小定義：Q7 的批次定義適用；三種方式（輸出量/輸入量/運行時間）；強烈建議採用「時間範圍」定義以獲得最大生產靈活性
blocks.en: Batch size definition: the Q7 definition of a batch applies; three approaches (output quantity/input quantity/run time); a "time range" definition is strongly recommended for maximum production flexibility

blocks.zh: Surge tank：緩衝各單元操作間的質量流速差異，維持系統整合穩定性的關鍵硬體元素
blocks.en: Surge tank: buffers differences in mass flow rate between unit operations; a key hardware element for maintaining the stability of system integration
